'''Stanik''' is a NPC male Roya student, found giving an presentation in Rabelle College classroom about Royan culture with Professor '''[[Pepys]]'''. 

{{color|help|Players can attend Professor Pepys class at <nowiki>12:00-18:00</nowiki> in the Rabelle College Classroom.}}

==Locations==

==Idle==
:'''Pepys:''' The calender used by the Roya shares similarities with the solar calender.
:'''Pepys:''' But the "sun" in their calender isn't the one in the sky. It's actually the Reactor Drive.
:'''Pepys:''' The Sacred Reactor Calender has been used by the Roya for generations, with the Solisylum calculating and publishing a new version each year.
:'''Pepys:''' Now, I'll hand it over to Stanik to walk us through how the calender has changed over the years...
:'''Stanik:''' Before we begin this discussion, there's something I need to clarify.
:'''Stanik:''' Roya customs devloped gradually around our mission here at Startorch.
:'''Stanik:''' The sun gives us day, night, and seasons. The Void Storms eat away at the world.
:'''Stanik:''' Shepherds help the Exoswarm migrate, and in doing so, gather data on the Reactor Drive and the Void Storms for the Solisylum.
:'''Stanik:''' In that way, you can say the calender is a custom that grew directly from our mission to tend to the Exoswarm and monitor Void Storms.
